subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 10:15 -0800
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the kickoff: 

Scope
- Pilot objective: validate automated invoice parsing + classification at 99% precision for line-item extraction over Acme's Q1 invoice set (approx 25k docs).
- Redwood deliverables: hosted POC environment, prompt/eval harness, baseline model config + one quantized variant for cost testing, integration adapter for S3 ingest.

Success metrics (what we'll measure)
- Extraction precision/recall on the agreed prompt set (primary metric: precision >= 99% for vendor/amount/line-item).
- Latency: 95th percentile response <= 250ms for batch size <= 4.
- Cost: per-document inference cost target <= $0.01 (post-quantization tuning).

Owners
- Acme: Jordan Ellis (POC lead), Sara Patel (data access & labeling), DevOps: acme-data@acmecorp.com
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (eng sponsor / program manager), Rishi Malhotra (solutions engineer / infra), Vivek Kulkarni (evaluation & prompt lead)

Timeline (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): access & onboarding, confirm dataset and sample prompts (we'll need a 200-doc seed).
- Week 1: baseline run + initial eval (precision/recall), infra tuning.
- Week 2–3: iterate prompts, enable quantized variant, cost measurement.
- Week 4: deliver final report + recommendations and optional follow-up rollout plan.

Access & setup items (what we need from Acme)
- S3 read-only bucket or temporary shared dataset export (sample 200 docs + representative negatives).
- Service account for Redwood with minimal IAM privileges OR a temporary AWS role for the POC (Rishi will send a checklist).
- Test data mapping doc (CSV): invoice_id -> s3_path -> expected fields.

Attachments included
- Redwood-Acme-POC-SOW-v1.pdf (scope + T&Cs)
- acme-access-checklist.xlsx (services + roles we need)

Next steps
1) Jordan: confirm dataset delivery method and point person for access (Sara?) by EOD Wednesday.
2) Rishi: will circulate the access checklist and a minimal terraform snippet for temporary role creation.
3) Schedule: I'll send calendar invites for the kickoff dev sync (30–45m) once access is in place.

If that all looks right, we'll treat this as the kickoff plan and proceed once you confirm dataset access.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Eng Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and matches our notes. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Confirmed: Sara will be the dataset owner and will start the export. She copied in this reply.

If that works, I'll aim to have the sample 200-doc export uploaded by Wednesday EOD. Looking forward to the kickoff.
